finding.claim: skipBusy's comment and its log line say catch-up retries next pass, but when the busy 409 comes from removeIfEmpty's recursive folder delete (after the file delete succeeded) the next pass never revisits that folder, because files() leaves out folders holding only summaries; the failure that used to surface as WARN "catch-up pass failed" now reads as a harmless INFO

fixes.change: TestLockConflictLogsBusy asserts the busy tries waited out Backoff(1) and Backoff(2); a catch-up subtest asserts a busy folder cleanup still fails the pass
remove wraps a failed cleanup of emptied folders in errFolderLeft
skipBusy drops a lock conflict only on the file, not on folder cleanup, and its comment says so
